Great lunch with an excellent range of beer
Jan 2023
We were staying at the nearby Maison de Camille and wanted a quick lunch that suited children who aren't quite ready for roadside Banh mi. This was perfect, portions were big (to the extent that two of us aren't eating tonight) and everything was fresh and tasted good. We went for a double hot dog, caesar salad, tuna melt and BBQ pork loaded fries and it all hit the spot with every plate clean. Service was fast and efficient and the kids enjoyed their drinks, a proper cream soda and a giant Arizona iced tea neither of which we have seen elsewhere. If you're in the area then it's definitely worth a look.

Nice food.....but please read the entire review
Jul 2020
Hungry Bunny is located some 3km from home here in HCMC. Great, another new breakfast hangout for me, so I thought........

For a start, location is in a busy street in the Binh Thanh district. This is good, since there are a variety of specialised restaurants and cafes in this area. The frontage of the restaurant is really non-descript, and unless you were specifically looking for this place, chances you will probably drive by with a second look.

The interior was rather bland, a couple of plain looking tables, paired with really uncomfortable hard surfaced chairs. It was quiet when I popped in at 945am on a Friday morning. Unsurprisingly, as breakfast crowds usually frequent before 9am so they could get to work, and lunch crowds aren’t out so early.

I was served by the singular working that shift. He was helpful and friendly but didn’t speak good English, but still of great personality.

I ordered the Han & Cheese sandwich with extras of avocado and a side of Apple Slaw, and a Ca Phe Da (Vietnamese iced clack coffee). The food took about 20 minutes to be served, slow as I was the only customer in the cafe. But to be fair, there was a constant stream of food delivery personnel.

The sandwich....well, of reasonable size, not too large, not too small was extremely delicious. It was probably the best, if not one the best ham & cheese sandwich in Vietnam.

As for the Apple Slaw, that’s another story. A quick look revealed a human hair, which to me was thoroughly disgusting and it immediately turned me off any food. The waiter immediately offered a change, he removed the offending plate of food, returned 5 minutes later with the same thing although I am unsure if he only removed the hair, or it was a freshly prepared Slaw. He did offer me a 20% of my bill (nice gesture), but I’d rather have clean food in lieu of a discount.

I’d be tempted to give it better ratings, but in all fairness contaminated food of any sort isn’t to be tolerated.
